analysis:
Examined ProviderLoop.swift head lines 1-1188. The only changed range is head 787-796, which adds new stored state. The added `coordinatorConnection` (DaemonState.CoordinatorConnection?) is diagnostic connection state reported to status/doctor. The other new fields are unauthorized-recovery bookkeeping: unauthorizedSince, lastUnauthorizedReconnectAt, unauthorizedReconnectAttempts and a random jitter. They are referenced by ProviderLoop+ServingAuthorizationRecovery, which is not supplied in this batch. DaemonState+Coding.swift adds coordinatorConnection to the CodingKeys (line 18) and adds decodeIfPresent/encodeIfPresent at lines 51/89. Those calls persist the field in the owner-only daemon state file.

No regression was identified from these declarations alone. Integration must still verify the following:
(1) The CoordinatorConnection struct contents must not serialize tokens (A-008), the X25519 key (A-003), App Attest credential or receipt identifiers (A-015, T-058), or endpoint nonces into the state file. The struct definition was not supplied.
(2) The unauthorized-reconnect logic must bound reconnect rate (availability) and must not treat a reconnect as re-establishing authorization or reusing stale grants (T-053, T-057, TB-011). Reconnect must still go through fresh endpoint custody proof.
(3) The decoded state file is operator-writable (TB-003). The CLI must treat coordinatorConnection as display-only and never as trust input.

The remaining code in the units (SendHandle flush ordering, key generation, attestation signer fallback) is unchanged.
